vault.intro: The folder where everything is stored: the database, the MIDI recordings and the images in your notes.
vault.syncText: The app does not upload anything to the internet. If you put the vault inside a synced folder (Dropbox, Syncthing, Nextcloud…), that service will make the copy. Close the app on one computer and wait for it to finish syncing before opening it on another: the database does not support changes in two places at once.

“{title}” will be deleted along with its raw recording, fragments, comments and images.

home.title: What are you practicing today?
home.subtitle: Record with your USB keyboard, keep the passages that matter and write down what you want to improve.

record.title: Record
record.text: Press Record and play. You can stop and carry on: each take is added to the end of the raw recording.

trim.title: Trim
trim.text: Select a passage on the recording and save it as a fragment. Discard whatever you don’t need.

annotate.title: Annotate
annotate.text: Leave comments at the exact second of each fragment, and notes with images.

fragments.explanationPlaceholder: What did you work on in this passage?
fragments.commentPlaceholder: What do you want to remember about this moment?
fragments.noComments: No comments yet. Write one while you listen.
fragments.commentsHint: Click a comment to jump to that moment.
fragments.deleteMessage_zero:
“{title}” will be deleted.
This cannot be undone.
fragments.deleteMessage_one:
“{title}” and its comment will be deleted.
This cannot be undone.
fragments.deleteMessage_other:
“{title}” and its {n} comments will be deleted.
This cannot be undone.

slicer.help: Drag over the recording to choose a passage · click to listen from there
slicer.footer: **Extract** saves the passage as a fragment and removes it from the raw recording. **Discard** deletes it without saving it.
slicer.extractNote: The passage is saved as a separate fragment and removed from the raw recording.
slicer.invalidTime: Invalid time format (use mm:ss or mm:ss.d)
slicer.discardMessage:
The section {start} – {end} ({duration}) will be removed from the raw recording.
Later events will shift to close the gap.
